slides.title: The gap is the execution environment, not the model
slides.subtitle: A document skill needs a place to run code and a path for files

items.title: What works today
items.body: Summarisation, classification, analysis and question answering all need one thing: the model. They run on Amazon Bedrock without change.

items.title: What does not
items.body: Deck and document generation also needs a sandbox to execute python-pptx and a way to hand the produced file back.

blocks.text: Inference succeeding while document generation fails is the signature of a missing execution environment.

notes: The model is not the problem
The missing pieces are a place to run code and a path for files
